result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: it provides a mutual cap equal to the greater of 12 months’ paid/payable fees and USD 1,000,000, a mutual indirect/consequential-damages exclusion, all required uncapped carve-outs, and the payment-obligations clarification. It preserves the core commercial intent, but is not strictly minimal because it additionally excludes incidental damages and the opening exception may also exempt Excluded Claims from the damages exclusion, not merely the cap. Drafting quality is reduced by the nonparallel definition of “Excluded Claims,” which awkwardly treats indemnification obligations, gross negligence, misconduct, fraud, and infringement as objects of “breach”; it should instead refer to liability arising from each category.
